title: Running the Semantic Source Store on Rexx/SQL + SQLite
summary: The store is backend-neutral: it takes any executor whose execute(sql) returns status, message and rows. SemanticSourceSqliteIndexPlan~open(path) returns such a session with the store's secondary indexes, created as the store creates each table. adapters/ssc/run_ssc_live_on_rexxsql.sh runs the store's own live suites, changing only the executor line, and they pass: round trip 28, MCP 14, mutation 18 checks, and the GA dogfood rebuilds 17 of 17 files byte-identical. GA imports in 3 s (NoSQLServer: 1,547 s for 15 of 17 files).
invariants: No NoSQLServer class is loaded on this path: the runner replaces ::requires NoSQLServer.cls.
CRLF is stored exactly on SQLite; on NoSQLServer the store refuses such imports (STORAGE_NOT_LOSSLESS).
The index plan removes every avoidable scan but costs ~14% at 2,295 revisions; its benefit at estate size is expected, not yet measured. SSC_INDEX_PLAN=0 switches it off.

provenance.claim: NoSQLServer comparison and corrected GA size.
